why_it_exists: Created in Q2 2022 to support EU PSD2 regulatory reporting. Consolidates payment events from three upstream sources (Stripe, Braintree, legacy Oracle). The denormalized structure was a deliberate performance decision — joins were causing 40s dashboard load times.
known_quirks: settlement_date is always NULL for cryptocurrency transactions — this is intentional and tracked in JIRA-8823. The 'status' column uses a non-standard enum ('COMPLETE' not 'COMPLETED') due to a legacy Oracle migration constraint that was never cleaned up.
business_context: Directly feeds the CFO dashboard and the monthly regulatory report to the ECB. Any schema change requires a two-week notice period per our data contract with the Finance team.
